fields.summary_ko.0: AMD (AMD) gained over 4% intraday in semiconductor stock bounce following Intel's poor results, with analyst consensus ahead of Q3 earnings guidance at EPS $1.97 and revenue $13 billion.
fields.summary_ko.1: Datacenter revenue expected to rise 88% year-over-year to $8.19 billion, while gaming segment forecast to plunge 49% to $655 million.
fields.summary_ko.2: Weak PC demand and price increases from memory and storage shortages are suppressing customer demand, with Windows 10 support end-of-life anniversary loss also weighing on results.
